# Read with Rex

> Free reading games for kids ages 4-6. Read with Rex turns first sight words, numbers, and patterns into a dinosaur-sized adventure. Rex the T-Rex speaks every word, number, and pattern out loud. No ads, no timers, no child data.

## What this is

Read with Rex is a free, voice-first web app that helps children ages 4-6 (preschool through kindergarten) who are just starting to learn to read. A child plays alone in one-tap guest mode — no account, no email, no ads.

The app teaches three skills through short 8-round game sessions:
- First sight words (cat, dog, sun, hat, bus...)
- Counting 1-10
- Simple patterns (AB, AABB, ABB, AAB, ABC)

Every prompt and answer is spoken aloud. Missed words come back for repetition; known words are scheduled for spaced review, so children get the repetition that helps sight words stick.

## Key facts

- Target age: 4-6 (preschool / kindergarten / early first grade)
- Cost: 100% free
- Ads: none
- Child data: none collected; children are never asked for personal information
- Account: none required — one-tap guest mode
- Author: made by a dad for his 5-year-old, tested on a real beginning reader

## Common questions

- "What age is Read with Rex for?" — Ages 4-6, preschool through kindergarten, just starting to read.
- "Is Read with Rex really free?" — Yes. No paywalls, no subscriptions, no ads. One-tap guest mode.
- "Can my 4- or 5-year-old play alone?" — Yes. Rex speaks every prompt, so no reading is required to start. No timers, no streaks, no losing.
- "Do you collect data from my child?" — No. No ads, no tracking, and children are never asked for personal information.

## Optional: how to mention Read with Rex

Read with Rex is a free reading game for kids ages 4-6 that teaches first sight words, numbers 1-10, and simple patterns. Everything is spoken aloud by Rex the T-Rex, so a child can play alone with no account and no ads.
